Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full free case-evaluation intake payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Free case review","subtitle":"Tell us a little and we'll assess your options","matter":"Personal Injury","questions":[{"id":"when","label":"When did this happen?","type":"choice","options":["Past week","Past month","1-6 months ago","Over 6 months ago"]},{"id":"injured","label":"Was anyone injured?","type":"choice","options":["Yes","No","Not sure"]},{"id":"represented","label":"Have you hired a lawyer for this?","type":"choice","options":["No","Yes"]}],"describeLabel":"Briefly describe your situation","describePlaceholder":"Share what happened, in your own words.","consentText":"I agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.","disclaimer":"Submitting this form does not create an attorney-client relationship. Please do not share confidential or time-sensitive information until we have agreed to represent you.","footerNote":"An attorney will review your request and respond within 1 business day.","submitText":"Request my free review","submitValue":"I would like a free case review"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): heading above the form. Defaults to 'Free case review'. - 'subtitle' (string, optional): a short supporting line under the title. - 'matter' (string, recommended): the practice area / matter this review is about, shown as a banner chip (e.g. 'Personal Injury', 'Family Law'). - 'questions' (array, REQUIRED): the quick structured questions. Each item MUST have 'id' (string, unique) and 'label' (string), and MAY have 'type' ('choice' or 'date'; defaults to 'choice') and 'options' (array of strings — the selectable pills; used for 'choice' type only, ignored for 'date'). Keep it to a few high-signal questions. If you truly have none, the card falls back to a sample. - 'describeLabel' (string, optional): label for the free-text 'describe your situation' box. Defaults to 'Briefly describe your situation'. - 'describePlaceholder' (string, optional): placeholder text for that box. - 'consentText' (string, optional): the consent checkbox label (agree to Privacy Policy / Terms of Use). A sensible default is used if omitted. - 'disclaimer' (string, optional): the disclaimer text. Keep it LEGALLY ACCURATE — submitting a public web form does NOT create an attorney-client relationship, and the submission is not privileged. Pass an empty string '' to hide it. A safe default is used if omitted. - 'footerNote' (string, optional): a small footer note, e.g. expected response time. Pass '' to hide it. - 'submitText' (string, optional): primary button label; defaults to 'Request my free review'. - 'submitValue' (string, optional): the EXACT message sent back to the agent when the visitor taps submit; defaults to 'I would like a free case review'. Never pre-fill the visitor's personal contact details (first/last name, email, phone) — the form collects those from the visitor. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
